changelog:
Initial release of mcp-server.

- Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to extend AI capabilities.
- Includes quick templates for weather, database, file management, and custom API servers.
- Supports deployment to multiple platforms and connectivity with AI agents (e.g., Claude, OpenClaw).
- Enables AI integration with external tools, services, and APIs.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and package manager (npm or yarn).
summary: Create and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI agents. MCP enables AI models to interact with external tools and services.
